evidence: Clicking New Resume created "Untitled Resume" editor with empty Contact fields (placeholders only), and empty Experience/Education tabs ready to add entries; editing was immediately possible.

Filled contact/summary; added, edited, reordered (up arrow), and removed experience entries; added education entry; added, edited (level Intermediate->Expert), added second, and removed skills - all reflected correctly in editor and live preview.
Start/End Date fields are HTML month inputs (type=month) requiring consistent YYYY-MM entry; preview renders as 'Mon YYYY' format consistently (e.g., 'Jul 2022 - Jan 2024').

issue: Invalid experience date range is silently accepted with no validation feedback
actual: Set Start Date=2022-07 and End Date=2020-01 (end before start) on an experience entry; the field accepted the value, no error/warning message appeared anywhere on the page, and the live preview rendered the nonsensical range 'Jul 2022 - Jan 2020' without any indication of invalidity.

evidence: Switched between Modern, Classic, and Minimal templates via Template tab; each switch changed the visual layout of Live Preview (different heading styles, date placement, bullet separators) while all content (name, contact, summary, experience, education, skills) remained intact.
All field edits (contact, summary, experience, education, skills) and template switches (Modern/Classic/Minimal) appeared instantly in the Live Preview panel with no save/refresh action required.

Renamed 'Work Experience' heading to 'Career History' (reflected live in preview), toggled Education section visibility off/on (removed/restored from preview), and moved Skills section above Education via up-arrow (order changed in both editor list and Live Preview).
Section visibility toggle and reorder (Skills moved above Education) updated Live Preview immediately without any save action.
Renamed Work Experience heading to 'Career History' in Sections tab; verified it displays as 'Career History' in Minimal, Modern, and Classic template previews.

With all 5 sections populated (Contact, Summary, 3 Experience entries, Skills, Education) in Minimal style, every visible section with content rendered in the Live Preview. Content exceeded viewport (document.scrollHeight 1574 vs window height 720) and remained reachable via page scroll, keeping the full resume readable.

Clicked Hide Preview - preview panel disappeared while editor tabs/content remained intact and editable full-width. Clicked Show Preview - Live Preview reappeared with all content (contact, summary, 3 experience entries, skills, education) and Classic template style fully preserved.

issue: No validation feedback shown when attempting to rename resume to whitespace-only title
actual: Clicked the resume title to edit, entered '   ' (whitespace only) and pressed Enter. The title correctly reverted to the previous 'Untitled Resume' (title was not changed to blank), but no toast, inline error, or any other validation feedback message was displayed to inform the user why the change was rejected.

evidence: Renamed resume from 'Untitled Resume' to 'QA Engineer Application' in editor; dashboard card now shows the same title 'QA Engineer Application' with updated timestamp.

After extensive editing across Contact/Summary/Experience/Education/Skills/Template/Sections tabs and renaming, navigating back to dashboard shows the resume card 'QA Engineer Application' with 'Updated Aug 24, 2026' (today's date) reflecting the edits.

Reopened 'QA Engineer Application' resume from dashboard after navigating away; Contact (Jane Tester, email, phone, location), Summary, all 3 Experience entries, Education, and Skills (Selenium) were all present exactly as previously edited.

Duplicated 'QA Engineer Application' via card '...' menu -> Duplicate, producing 'QA Engineer Application (Copy)' with identical content. Renamed copy to 'Marketing Role Application' via title click-to-edit. Edited copy's Full Name to 'Jane Marketer' and Location remained 'Austin, TX' unaffected by later edits to the original; original 'QA Engineer Application' retained its own Full Name 'Jane Tester' throughout.

Bidirectional independence confirmed: (1) edited copy's Full Name to 'Jane Marketer' -> reopened original, Full Name still 'Jane Tester' (unaffected). (2) edited original's Location to 'Denver, CO' -> reopened copy 'Marketing Role Application', Location still 'Austin, TX' and Full Name still 'Jane Marketer' (unaffected). All other shared content (summary, experience, education, skills) remained consistent independently in both.

During this session, created a new resume from scratch ('QA Engineer Application', classic template) and duplicated it into a second distinct resume ('Marketing Role Application'), each independently edited (different Full Name, Location) and both persisted as separate cards on the dashboard alongside the 3 pre-existing seed resumes (Product Designer Resume, Marketing Manager Resume, Software Engineer Resume) - 5 distinct resumes managed concurrently without data collision.

Search: typing lowercase 'marketing' into Search resumes box correctly filtered to only 'Marketing Role Application' and 'Marketing Manager Resume' (case-insensitive substring match against titles), hiding the other 3. Clearing the search field restored all 5 resumes. Sort: dropdown offers 'Newest First', 'Oldest First', 'Title A-Z', 'Title Z-A'. Default 'Newest First' ordered cards by Updated date descending (Marketing Role Application/QA Engineer Application Aug 24 2026 first, then Product Designer Feb 25 2024, Marketing Manager Feb 10 2024, Software Engineer Jan 20 2024 last). Switching to 'Oldest First' correctly reversed the order (Software Engineer first ... Marketing Role Application last).

issue: No date-based filtering feature exists on the dashboard
actual: Inspected dashboard for a date filter control (exact date or date range): only a title search textbox and a sort-order combobox (Newest First/Oldest First/Title A-Z/Title Z-A) exist. A DOM query for date/filter/calendar-related inputs or buttons returned no elements. Typing the exact 'Updated' date string of an existing resume ('Feb 10, 2024', matching Marketing Manager Resume's displayed date) into the search box returned 'No resumes found' - confirming the search only matches titles, not dates, and there is no separate mechanism to filter resumes by creation/updated date or date range as required by the checklist.

issue: Resume data is not persisted across page reloads - all created/edited/duplicated resumes are lost
actual: Prior to reload, the dashboard had 5 resumes: the 3 original seed resumes plus a newly created 'QA Engineer Application' (extensively edited: renamed, contact/summary/experience/education/skills filled, section reordered, heading renamed to 'Career History', location changed to 'Denver, CO') and its duplicate 'Marketing Role Application' (renamed and independently edited). After reloading the app via browser_navigate to the same URL, the dashboard reverted to showing only the original 3 seed resumes (Product Designer Resume, Marketing Manager Resume, Software Engineer Resume) - both newly created resumes and all their edits were completely lost. A DOM check confirmed localStorage and sessionStorage are both empty, indicating the app holds resume data only in transient in-memory state with no persistence layer, so any created, edited, duplicated, or renamed resume does not survive a page reload.
